subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 3 — System Requirements Engineering, Elicitation Techniques & Analysis Paradigms
moduleDescription: Rigorous investigation of software requirements engineering, formal requirements classification (Business, User, and System Requirements under IEEE 830 / ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148), Functional vs. Non-Functional Requirements (ISO/IEC 25010 Quality Model, SLA/SLO quantification, and domain constraints), fact-finding and elicitation methodologies (Structured/Unstructured Interviews, Questionnaires, Joint Application Development [JAD], Observation, Archival Document Audits), and a comparative architectural evaluation of Structured Analysis (DFDs, Data Dictionaries, Decision Tables) versus Object-Oriented Analysis (UML 2.5, Use Cases, Domain Class Modeling).
